add_library(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}peripherals_port INTERFACE)
add_library(hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}peripherals_port ALIAS hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}peripherals_port)
target_include_directories(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}peripherals_port INTERFACE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/port
)
target_link_libraries(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}peripherals_port INTERFACE
    proj::options hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}gpio_headers)

add_library(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}gpio_headers INTERFACE)
add_library(hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}gpio_headers ALIAS hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}gpio_headers)
target_include_directories(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}gpio_headers INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}gpio_headers INTERFACE ${HC32_PORT})
if(HC32_PORTABLE AND NOT PORTABLE_DRIVERS AND NOT PORTABLE_SPI AND NOT PORTABLE_GPIO)
    return()
endif()
if(NOT HC32_PORTABLE)
    file(GLOB PERIPHERAL_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS *.c *.cpp)
    if(NOT PRODUCT_HAS_DISPLAY)
        list(FILTER PERIPHERAL_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "SpiMaster[.]cpp$")
    endif()
elseif(PORTABLE_DRIVERS)
    set(PERIPHERAL_SOURCES I2cMaster.cpp)
elseif(PORTABLE_SPI)
    set(PERIPHERAL_SOURCES SpiMaster.cpp)
elseif(PORTABLE_GPIO)
    set(PERIPHERAL_SOURCES gpio.c pinmap.cpp)
endif()
add_library(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}peripherals OBJECT ${PERIPHERAL_SOURCES})
add_library(hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}peripherals ALIAS hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}peripherals)
target_link_libraries(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}peripherals PUBLIC ${HC32_PORT} hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}gpio_headers)
if(NOT HC32_PORTABLE OR PORTABLE_GPIO)
    target_link_libraries(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}peripherals PUBLIC hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}peripherals_port)
endif()
if(NOT HC32_PORTABLE)
    target_link_libraries(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}peripherals PUBLIC hc32::system)
endif()
